\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{graphs}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \graph[
    grow right=2cm,
    branch down=1.2cm,
    empty nodes,
    nodes={circle,draw,minimum size=7mm},
    edges={-latex,thick}
  ] {
    source[as=Start,fill=green!15] ->
    {review[as=Review,fill=yellow!20], wait[fill=gray!15]} ->
    done[as=Done,fill=blue!12];
  };
\end{tikzpicture}
